title: coordkit event envelope v2
description: One append-only JSON event per line in the coordination log. v1 events (no schema_version) are read tolerantly as 1.0: readers pass them through VERBATIM and treat any absent v2 field as its default — no on-read rewrite happens. (schema/migrations/0001_v1_to_v2.sh is an OPTIONAL offline/manual up-converter and is NOT invoked on the read path.) Stored lines are NEVER rewritten.

schema_version.description: Envelope version, major.minor. Readers MUST ignore unknown fields and treat a missing value as "1.0".

eid.description: Content-addressed id over canonical(event minus eid,sig). The cross-replica DEDUP key and audit anchor. e.g. "sha256:9f3c…" (blake3 if b3sum is present).

id.description: Sortable unique id (ULID-like). Tiebreak + display only; not the dedup key.

actor.description: STABLE per (machine + user + clone) site id. Partitions the committed filespace so two writers never touch the same segment file.

clock.description: Per-actor monotonic clock: wall-ms + counter. Advances past the max observed clock. Total order across replicas = sort by (clock.p, clock.c, actor) — machine-independent, NOT wall-clock last-writer-wins.

c.description: monotonic counter, advanced past max observed

seq.description: LOCAL-only convenience counter (per physical log). NOT authoritative for cross-machine order — use clock.

user.description: Identity for multi-user trust (server-stamped from the verified token in relay mode).

type.description: Event type. KNOWN types: note, decision, question, answer, task, claim, done, block. This list is DOCUMENTATION, not a closed set — readers MUST tolerate unknown types as opaque notes, so validation accepts any string. Producers SHOULD stick to the known types.

subject.description: Reconciliation key: the latest non-superseded event per subject wins.

body.description: Free-text payload. A task body may carry 'dep:<subject>' tokens for ordering.

refs.description: Content refs (eids) instead of fragile numeric seq refs.

lease.description: ALWAYS an object from v2 onward (never a bare scalar). null when not a claim.

until.description: epoch seconds the lease is valid until

supersedes.description: eid of the prior version of this subject (explicit version chain for audit/history).

sig.description: OPTIONAL detached ed25519 signature over canonical(event minus sig). Absent (null) in default local mode.
